verdict.rationale: Mesh lets users generate API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date, so an agent can be given a scoped, time-limited key. Endpoint docs list named permissions (e.g. "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which points to a granular permission model. Missing for 10: a full catalog of permission scopes showing how fine-grained least-privilege can get, any documented programmatic or API-based credential issuance or rotation for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
